questions.question: During a violent storm at sea, the disciples woke the sleeping Jesus and called Him Teacher. What did they ask Him?

answers.text: Whether He cared that they were perishing
Whether they should turn back to shore
Whether He could help them row

questions.question: When Jesus told the wind and the sea to be silent and still, what happened?

answers.text: The wind died down and it was perfectly calm
The waves stopped but the wind kept blowing
The storm slowly faded through the night

questions.question: After Jesus calmed the wind and sea, what was the first question He asked His disciples?

answers.text: Why did you wake Me up
Why didn't you steer for shore

questions.question: Overwhelmed with fear after the storm stopped, what did Jesus' disciples ask one another?

answers.text: Who is this that even the wind and the sea obey Him
How are we ever going to get back to the shore
Where did such a terrible storm come from so fast
